definitions.definition: Contract generation is now dynamic and integrated with CRM systems.
Templates consolidate state-specific clauses for error-free automation.
Documents are stored as searchable PDFs for audits and compliance.

policies.Shipping: Standardized shipping terms are applied across regions, improving efficiency.
policies.Delivery: Digital delivery reduces delays and manual handling risks.
policies.Return: Custom clauses allow client-specific return conditions.
Warranty: Facturas de Argentina warrants all services comply with local laws.
Custom warranties can be dynamically inserted per client.
Proof of purchase is required for claims.

GeneralProvisions.provision: Contracts adhere to CABA laws and arbitration rules.
All agreements include clear audit trails.
